decisions.reason: The original Statement never assigns real values to f, contrary to def-distinct-node-divided-difference, and defines G_i only for i<n-d although the final recurrence uses G_{n-d}. Added real nodes, a distinct real query, arbitrary real node/query data, and definitions for all 0<=i<=n-d; the identity remains for i<n-d. Symmetry puts x_i and x_{i+d+1} at the recursive endpoints, giving (G_{i+1}-G_i)/(x_{i+d+1}-x_i); rearrangement proves the sign and coefficient, including d=0,n=1.

The supplier Statement asserts nonidentity of Q, but its complete Proof 1.1 explicitly computes Q(z_j)=w_j product_(ell!=j)(z_j-z_ell), and Proof 2.1 proves this is nonzero for each arbitrary j. Thus F2 cites an actually established supplier consequence, not an unsupported strengthening. Moreover this item Proof 2.1 itself evaluates both finite sums; nonzero weights and distinct nodes make the displayed Q value nonzero. Interpolation and the cancellation claim follow, including k=1 and a zero numerator.

The Statement concerns p_i from def-floater-hormann-window-polynomial, which explicitly imports the nodes, data and degree parameter of def-floater-hormann-interpolant. That Definition assumes x_0<...<x_n real and real data. Thus each window is already strictly increasing, and Given also says as in the Floater-Hormann definition. Reindexing its d+1 nodes by 0,...,d meets the cardinal theorem exactly. The local products give the nodal values, uniqueness gives partition of unity, and d=0 uses the empty product 1.
